# Flux Media Systems — Free Web Calculators & Tools
> A collection of 50 free, single-purpose calculators covering finance, health, property, legal, and pet care.
> All tools run in the browser. No login required. No data stored on servers. UK and US coverage throughout.

## Guides

**Stamp Duty Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/stamp-duty-guide.html
Description: Complete guide to UK Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) in 2026. Covers rates for standard purchases, first-time buyers, second homes, and non-UK residents. Includes worked examples.

**Mortgage Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/mortgage-guide.html
Description: How UK mortgages work — repayment vs interest-only, fixed vs variable rates, LTV impact on rates, the application process, and how overpayments save interest.

**Rent vs Buy Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/rent-vs-buy-guide.html
Description: Detailed comparison of renting vs buying a home in the UK — total costs, opportunity cost of the deposit, house price growth assumptions, and break-even timeline.

**Redundancy Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/redundancy-guide.html
Description: UK redundancy rights guide covering statutory redundancy pay, notice periods, garden leave, PILON, the redundancy selection process, and what to do if redundancy is unfair.

**Pet Medication Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/pet-medication-guide.html
Description: Guide to common dog and cat medications — dosage principles, giving tablets and liquids, storage, and when to contact a vet. References Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook.

**Compound Interest Guide**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/guides/compound-interest-guide.html
Description: How compound interest works, the Rule of 72, how compounding frequency affects returns, and how to use compound interest to grow savings over time.

## Finance & Property Tools

**Mortgage Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/mortgage-calculator/
Description: Calculate mortgage monthly payments, total interest, and amortization schedule. Estimates affordability based on income using 28%/36% DTI rule. Covers UK and US. Includes extra payment savings.
Keywords: mortgage calculator, monthly mortgage payment, mortgage affordability, home loan calculator, amortization

**Mortgage Overpayment Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/mortgage-overpayment-calculator/
Description: Calculate exactly how much interest you save and how many years you cut off your mortgage by making monthly overpayments or lump sum overpayments.
Keywords: mortgage overpayment calculator, overpay mortgage, save interest on mortgage, pay off mortgage early

**Stamp Duty Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/stamp-duty-calculator/
Description: Calculate UK Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) for standard purchases, first-time buyers (nil-rate up to £500k), and second homes (3% surcharge). Uses 2025/26 rates.
Keywords: stamp duty calculator, SDLT calculator, first time buyer stamp duty, stamp duty 2026

**LTV Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/ltv-calculator/
Description: Calculate Loan-to-Value ratio for UK mortgage purchases or remortgages. Shows which LTV band applies and typical rate implication of each band (60% to 95%).
Keywords: LTV calculator, loan to value, mortgage LTV, remortgage LTV, deposit percentage

**Home Affordability Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/home-affordability-calculator/
Description: Calculate how much house you can afford in the UK based on gross income, deposit size, existing debts, and current mortgage rates. Uses 4.5x income multiplier.
Keywords: home affordability calculator, how much house can I afford, mortgage affordability UK

**Home Equity Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/home-equity-calculator/
Description: Calculate how much equity you have in your home and how much you could borrow through a remortgage or equity release.
Keywords: home equity calculator, how much equity do I have, equity release calculator, remortgage equity

**Rent vs Buy Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/rent-vs-buy-calculator/
Description: Compare the true long-term cost of renting vs buying in the UK. Factors in house price growth, deposit opportunity cost, rent increases, maintenance, and transaction costs. Shows break-even year.
Keywords: rent vs buy calculator, is it cheaper to rent or buy, rent or buy UK

**Rental Yield Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/rental-yield-calculator/
Description: Calculate gross and net rental yield on a buy-to-let property. Net yield accounts for mortgage interest, letting agent fees, maintenance, insurance, and void periods.
Keywords: rental yield calculator, gross rental yield, net rental yield, buy to let yield

**Property Tax Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/property-tax-calculator/
Description: Estimate UK council tax by band and local authority, or US property tax by state. Covers all UK council tax bands A–H and average effective rates for all US states.
Keywords: property tax calculator, council tax calculator, UK council tax bands, US property tax by state

**Renovation Cost Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/renovation-cost-calculator/
Description: Estimate UK home renovation costs for kitchens, bathrooms, loft conversions, single/double extensions, and full house refurbishments. Adjusts for size and quality level.

**Moving House Cost Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/moving-cost-calculator/
Description: Estimate total UK moving house costs including removal company, solicitor conveyancing fees, survey costs, estate agent fees, and mortgage arrangement fees.

**Loan Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/loan-calculator/
Description: Calculate monthly loan repayments, total interest paid, and full amortization schedule for any loan. Shows savings from extra payments. Includes repayment chart.

**Investment Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/investment-calculator/

URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/retirement-calculator/
Description: Project retirement savings and determine if you can retire by a target date. Uses 4% safe withdrawal rule. Includes Social Security or UK State Pension income.

**Freelancer Rate Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/freelancer-rate-calculator/
Description: Calculate the minimum hourly or day rate a freelancer needs to charge to hit a desired net income. Accounts for self-employment tax, unpaid leave, non-billable hours, and expenses.

**Salary Calculator**

Description: Calculate net take-home pay from gross salary. Covers all 50 US states (state income tax, FICA) and UK (Income Tax, National Insurance, student loan repayment).

## Legal Tools

**Redundancy Pay Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/redundancy-pay-calculator/
Description: Calculate UK statutory redundancy pay based on age, years of service, and weekly pay. Uses 2025/26 weekly pay cap (£719). Shows age-banded multiplier breakdown and total entitlement.
Keywords: redundancy pay calculator, statutory redundancy pay, redundancy calculator UK 2026

**Notice Period Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/notice-period-calculator/
Description: Find UK statutory minimum notice period by years of service and calculate pay in lieu of notice (PILON). Covers employer and employee obligations under the Employment Rights Act 1996.
Keywords: notice period calculator, PILON calculator, pay in lieu of notice, statutory notice period UK

**Employment Tribunal Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/employment-tribunal-calculator/
Description: Estimate basic award and compensatory award for UK unfair dismissal tribunal claims. Uses 2025/26 weekly pay cap (£719) and maximum compensatory award (£115,115).
Keywords: employment tribunal calculator, unfair dismissal compensation, basic award calculator UK

**Alimony Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/alimony-calculator/
Description: Estimate spousal maintenance (UK) or alimony (US) based on marriage length, income difference, and jurisdiction. For guidance only — outcomes vary widely by court.
Keywords: alimony calculator, spousal maintenance calculator, spousal support estimator, divorce maintenance UK

**Divorce Asset Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/divorce-asset-calculator/
Description: Model how property, savings, pensions, and debts might be divided in a UK or US divorce financial settlement based on equitable distribution principles.
Keywords: divorce asset calculator, financial settlement calculator, divorce property split, matrimonial assets

**Child Support Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/child-support-calculator/
Description: Estimate UK child maintenance using the Child Maintenance Service (CMS) formula based on gross weekly income and number of children. Also covers US state income shares model.
Keywords: child support calculator, child maintenance calculator, CMS calculator UK, child maintenance 2026

**Small Claims Court Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/small-claims-calculator/
Description: Check if a claim qualifies for small claims, calculate court fees, and see claim limits for England & Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, and all 50 US states.
Keywords: small claims calculator, small claims court fees, small claims limit UK, small claims court US

**Statute of Limitations Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/statute-of-limitations/
Description: Check if a legal claim is still within time. Covers personal injury, breach of contract, debt, and property for all US states and UK (Limitation Act 1980).
Keywords: statute of limitations calculator, limitation period UK, is my claim in time, legal time limit

**Inheritance Tax Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/inheritance-tax-calculator/
Description: Estimate UK Inheritance Tax using the 2025/26 nil-rate band (£325,000), residence nil-rate band (£175,000), and rules for married couples, charitable gifts, and taper relief.
Keywords: inheritance tax calculator, IHT calculator, estate tax UK, nil rate band 2026

**Late Payment Interest Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/late-payment-interest/
Description: Calculate statutory late payment interest on overdue B2B invoices under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts Act 1998. Rate is 8% plus Bank of England base rate. Includes debt recovery costs.
Keywords: late payment interest calculator, statutory interest invoices, late payment act, overdue invoice interest UK

## Health Tools

**Pregnancy Due Date Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/pregnancy-calculator/
Description: Calculate due date from LMP, conception date, IVF transfer date, or ultrasound. Shows weeks pregnant, trimester, days remaining, baby size by week, and key milestones.
Keywords: pregnancy calculator, due date calculator, how many weeks pregnant, pregnancy due date

**Ovulation & Fertile Window Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/ovulation-calculator/
Description: Calculate ovulation day, fertile window, and next period from cycle length and luteal phase. Includes 3-month colour-coded calendar showing period, fertile, ovulation, and PMS days.
Keywords: ovulation calculator, fertile window calculator, when am I fertile, period tracker, conception calculator

**Blood Pressure Tracker**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/blood-pressure-tracker/
Description: Log and track blood pressure readings over time. Classifies readings using AHA 2017 guidelines (Normal / Elevated / Stage 1 / Stage 2 / Hypertensive Crisis). Trend chart included. Saves locally.
Keywords: blood pressure tracker, blood pressure log, blood pressure chart, hypertension tracker, normal blood pressure

**Type 2 Diabetes Risk Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/diabetes-risk-calculator/
Description: Assess Type 2 diabetes risk using ADA criteria — age, BMI, waist, activity, family history, diet, blood pressure, gestational history. Provides risk rating and personalised action plan.
Keywords: diabetes risk calculator, type 2 diabetes risk, am I at risk of diabetes, prediabetes test

**Sleep Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/sleep-calculator/
Description: Find optimal sleep and wake times based on 90-minute sleep cycles to avoid waking mid-cycle. Includes sleep debt calculator showing cumulative weekly deficit by age group.
Keywords: sleep calculator, best time to wake up, sleep cycle calculator, sleep debt calculator

**Body Fat Percentage Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/body-fat-calculator/
Description: Calculate body fat using the US Navy formula (waist/neck/hips) or BMI-based Deurenberg formula. Shows fat mass, lean mass, fitness category, and healthy range by sex.
Keywords: body fat calculator, body fat percentage, navy body fat formula, body composition calculator

**Calorie Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/calorie-calculator/
Description: Calculate daily calorie needs using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. Outputs BMR, TDEE, and calorie targets for weight loss (−500 kcal), maintenance, and muscle gain (+500 kcal). Includes macro split.
Keywords: calorie calculator, TDEE calculator, daily calorie needs, how many calories to lose weight, BMR calculator

**Drug Interaction Checker**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/drug-interaction-checker/
Description: Check interactions between medications or supplements using the OpenFDA drug label database. Displays interaction descriptions and severity (major / moderate / minor).
Keywords: drug interaction checker, medication interaction checker, supplement interactions, medicine checker

**Age Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/age-calculator/
Description: Calculate exact age in years, months, weeks, and days from a birthdate. Shows days until next birthday and age on any target date.
Keywords: age calculator, how old am I, exact age calculator, birthday calculator, age in days

## Pet Tools

**Dog Age Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-age-calculator/
Description: Convert dog years to human years using the DNA methylation-based formula (UC San Diego, 2019), not the old multiply-by-7 rule. Works for all breed sizes.
Keywords: dog age calculator, dog years to human years, how old is my dog in human years

**Cat Age Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/cat-age-calculator/
Description: Convert cat years to human years using AAHA/AAFP feline life-stage guidelines. Covers kitten, junior, adult, mature, senior, and geriatric life stages.
Keywords: cat age calculator, cat years to human years, how old is my cat in human years

**Dog Calorie Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-calorie-calculator/
Description: Calculate a dog's daily calorie needs using the RER formula endorsed by veterinary nutritionists. Adjusts for neuter status, life stage, activity level, and weight status.
Keywords: dog calorie calculator, how many calories does my dog need, RER dog, dog daily calories

**Cat Calorie Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/cat-calorie-calculator/
Description: Calculate a cat's daily calorie needs based on weight, neuter status, age, and activity using NRC-recommended RER formulas. Helps prevent feline obesity and malnutrition.
Keywords: cat calorie calculator, how many calories does my cat need, feline calorie calculator

**Dog Food Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-food-calculator/
Description: Calculate how much food to feed a dog per day based on weight, age, activity level, and food type (dry kibble, wet, raw, or mixed). Converts calories to grams or cups.
Keywords: dog food calculator, how much to feed my dog, dog feeding guide, dog food portion

**Dog Water Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-water-calculator/
Description: Calculate how much water a dog should drink daily based on weight, activity level, and diet type. Includes signs of dehydration and overhydration, and when to see a vet.
Keywords: dog water intake calculator, how much water should my dog drink, dog hydration

**Dog Weight Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-weight-calculator/
Description: Check if a dog is at a healthy weight using Body Condition Score (BCS) guidelines from veterinary nutritionists. Shows ideal weight range and status (underweight/healthy/overweight).
Keywords: dog ideal weight calculator, is my dog overweight, dog healthy weight, body condition score

**Dog Pregnancy Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/dog-pregnancy-calculator/
Description: Calculate a dog's due date and week-by-week pregnancy milestones from mating or conception date. Covers the 63-day gestation with signs of labour and whelping checklist.
Keywords: dog pregnancy calculator, dog due date calculator, whelping date, canine gestation period

**Puppy Growth Calculator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/puppy-growth-calculator/
Description: Predict a puppy's adult weight from current age and weight using breed-size-specific growth curves (toy/small/medium/large/giant). Shows percentage of adult size reached and fully-grown date.
Keywords: puppy growth calculator, how big will my puppy get, puppy adult weight, puppy weight chart

**Pet Insurance Cost Estimator**
URL: https://fluxmediasystems.com/pet-insurance-calculator/
Description: Estimate monthly pet insurance premiums for dogs and cats based on breed, age, location, and coverage type (accident-only / accident & illness / comprehensive).
Keywords: pet insurance calculator, how much does pet insurance cost, dog insurance, cat insurance
